Xin.name: Wang Mang
Xin.title: Emperor of Xin
Xin.note: Took the throne from the Han; killed when rebels stormed Chang'an in 23 CE.
Xin.note_zh: 篡汉建新，23年起义军攻入长安时被杀。

Xiongnu.name: Nangzhiyasi
Xiongnu.title: Wuzhuliuruodi Chanyu
Xiongnu.note: Broke with Wang Mang, who had downgraded the Xiongnu ruler's seal and title.
Xiongnu.note_zh: 王莽更换单于印信、贬低其称号，匈奴与新朝决裂。

Xiongnu.name: Yu
Xiongnu.title: Huduershidaogaoruodi Chanyu
Xiongnu.title_zh: 呼都而尸道皋若鞮单于

lulin.note: In 21 CE the rebels beat the Jing Province army sent against them; an epidemic in 22 CE split them into separate armies.
lulin.note_zh: 21年绿林军击败前来镇压的荆州官军；22年因疫病分为几支队伍。

red-eyebrows.note: In 22 CE the Red Eyebrows routed Wang Mang's army at Chengchang.
red-eyebrows.note_zh: 22年赤眉军在成昌大败王莽派来的大军。

liu-xiu-rises.note: After an early defeat at Xiao Chang'an, the brothers joined the Lülin and killed the Xin generals at the Bi River early in 23 CE.
liu-xiu-rises.note_zh: 兄弟二人在小长安初战失利，联合绿林军后于23年初在沘水击杀新军主将。
liu-xiu-rises.losses: Zhen Fu and Liangqiu Ci killed

sides.name: Han rebels
sides.troops_text: 8,000-9,000 in the town plus a relief force of a few thousand
sides.troops_text_zh: 城中守军八九千人，另有数千援兵

sides.name: Xin
sides.troops_text: c. 420,000, claimed as one million (Book of the Later Han)

kunyang.note: Liu Xiu broke out to gather help and charged with about 3,000 men; a storm and flooded river turned the Xin retreat into a rout. The Xin figure is surely inflated.
kunyang.note_zh: 刘秀突围搬来援兵，亲率约三千人冲阵；暴风雨中河水暴涨，新军溃退中大批淹死。新军人数必有夸大。
kunyang.losses: Wang Xun killed; the Xin army destroyed
kunyang.losses_zh: 王寻战死，新军主力覆没

routes.name: Wang Mang's army marches to Kunyang
routes.summary: Wang Yi and Wang Xun led the huge Xin army from Luoyang south through Yingchuan to besiege Kunyang, where Liu Xiu destroyed it.
routes.summary_zh: 王邑、王寻率新朝大军从洛阳南下，经颍川围攻昆阳，被刘秀击溃。

routes.name: Rebels take Chang'an
routes.summary: After Kunyang the Gengshi Emperor's armies went west through the Wu Pass and stormed Chang'an; Wang Mang was killed in the palace.
routes.summary_zh: 昆阳之战后，更始政权的军队西进武关，攻破长安，王莽在宫中被杀。

routes.name: Red Eyebrows march west
routes.summary: Rising in Shandong, the Red Eyebrows beat Xin at Chengchang and later marched west through Yingchuan and the Wu Pass, taking Chang'an in 25 CE.
routes.summary_zh: 赤眉军起于山东，在成昌击败新军，后经颍川、武关西进，于25年攻入长安。

routes.name: Liu Xiu's mission to Hebei
routes.summary: Sent north by the Gengshi Emperor, Liu Xiu fled from Ji when the pretender Wang Lang rose, rallied support at Xindu and took Handan in 24 CE: the base for his later Eastern Han.
routes.summary_zh: 刘秀受更始帝派遣北上河北，王郎起兵后从蓟城出逃，在信都聚集力量，24年攻下邯郸，奠定日后建立东汉的基础。

people.name: Yang Xiong
people.known_for: Poet and philosopher famed for rhapsodies, a dialect dictionary and works modelled on the Analects and Book of Changes.
people.known_for_zh: 辞赋家、哲学家，著有方言词典，并仿《论语》《周易》著书。

people.name: Liu Xin
people.known_for: Scholar and astronomer who catalogued the imperial library, championed Old Text classics and served Wang Mang.
people.known_for_zh: 学者、天文学家，编成图书目录《七略》，推崇古文经，为王莽重臣。

people.name: Wang Mang
people.known_for: Usurper who founded the Xin dynasty and launched sweeping land and currency reforms that ended in revolt.
people.known_for_zh: 篡汉建立新朝，推行土地币制改制，引发天下大乱。

people.name: Lü Mu
people.known_for: Woman who led an uprising against Xin to avenge her son, one of China's first female rebel leaders.
people.known_for_zh: 为子复仇起兵反新，中国最早的女性起义领袖之一。

people.name: Fan Chong
people.known_for: Leader of the Red Eyebrows peasant army, who painted their brows red and sacked Chang'an.
people.known_for_zh: 赤眉军首领，以赤眉为号，攻入长安。

people.name: Liu Yan (Bosheng)
people.known_for: Elder brother of Liu Xiu who raised the Han restoration army in Nanyang against Wang Mang.
people.known_for_zh: 刘秀之兄，在南阳起兵反莽，倡导复汉。

people.name: Gengshi Emperor (Liu Xuan)
people.known_for: Lülin-backed Han claimant whose forces destroyed Wang Mang in 23 CE.
people.known_for_zh: 绿林军拥立的汉帝，其军于23年攻灭王莽。

people.name: Yan You
people.known_for: Xin general and strategist who warned Wang Mang against war with the Xiongnu and fought at Kunyang.
people.known_for_zh: 新朝将领、兵法家，谏阻伐匈奴，参与昆阳之战。

people.name: Huan Tan
people.known_for: Skeptical thinker and musician who rejected prophetic apocrypha, author of New Treatise.
people.known_for_zh: 思想家、音乐家，反对谶纬，著《新论》。

people.name: Emperor Guangwu of Han (Liu Xiu)
people.known_for: Restorer of the Han who won the Battle of Kunyang and founded the Eastern Han at Luoyang.
people.known_for_zh: 昆阳之战大破新军，重建汉朝，定都洛阳。

people.name: Ma Yuan
people.known_for: 'Wave-Calming General' who suppressed the Trung sisters' revolt and vowed to die wrapped in a horse hide.
people.known_for_zh: 伏波将军，平定交趾二征起事，“马革裹尸”。

people.name: Wu Han
people.known_for: Grand marshal who conquered Gongsun Shu's Chengdu, completing the Eastern Han reunification.
people.known_for_zh: 大司马，攻灭公孙述，完成东汉统一。

people.name: Gongsun Shu
people.known_for: Warlord who declared himself emperor of Chengjia in Sichuan until conquered by Eastern Han.
people.known_for_zh: 割据蜀地称帝，国号成家，后为东汉所灭。

people.name: Wei Xiao
people.known_for: Warlord of Longxi who wavered between Liu Xiu and Gongsun Shu, inspiring the phrase 'having won Long, eye Shu'.
people.known_for_zh: 割据陇右的军阀，留下“得陇望蜀”典故。

people.name: Yan Guang
people.known_for: Recluse friend of Liu Xiu who refused office to fish on the Fuchun River, a model of integrity.
people.known_for_zh: 光武帝故友，拒绝出仕，隐居富春江垂钓。

check.n: Wikipedia gives c. 1-75; Chinese sources give 39 BC-AD 41. Sources disagree.
check.n_zh: 英文维基作约1—75年，中文资料作前39—41年，说法分歧。

people.name: Du Shi
people.known_for: Prefect of Nanyang who invented the water-powered bellows for casting iron.
people.known_for_zh: 南阳太守，发明水排鼓风冶铁。

capitals.name: Chang'an
capitals.note: Wang Mang renamed Chang'an as 常安; the city fell in 23 CE.
capitals.note_zh: 王莽改长安为常安，公元23年城破。

capitals.name: Luoyang
capitals.note: Gengshi Emperor's capital before moving to Chang'an.
capitals.note_zh: 更始帝定都洛阳，次年迁长安。
